findings.title: Gaza authorities record 6,405 Israeli violations of ceasefire in 410 days
findings.affected_population_system: Humanitarian aid supply and cross-border movement: Gaza Government Media Office reports 80,937 trucks entered versus 246,000 stipulated and 15,794 people traveled in both directions via Rafah versus 43,200 stipulated, across 410 days. It also reports 223 detentions and 6,405 ceasefire violations in that reporting period. These are attributed cumulative figures, not new hourly incidents.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Israel allowed only 80,937 out of 246,000 aid trucks agreed under agreement, media office says
findings.source_type: News agency citing Gaza Government Media Office statement

findings.location: Damon prison, Israel; detainees include women from Gaza
findings.affected_population_system: Prisoner organizations' joint statement reports 85 Palestinian female prisoners, including two from Gaza, three girls and one pregnant woman across the whole population. It alleges forced removal of headscarves at Damon and denial of healthcare, among other abuses. No Gaza-specific individual victim of these particular practices identified.
